  WHY: When FINAL_CI_FAILED_SYNC_QUICK=true the script exits early without posting a marker or dispatching review, contrary to the inventory.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:308 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The entry claims the script posts one `ai:final-ci-failed:v1` marker per head and dispatches the PR's review workflow. On FINAL_CI_FAILED_SYNC_QUICK=true (set by ci.yml:4604) the script instead dispatches the head's full final CI run (scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:89-101) and posts no marker.
  WHY: Readers will expect a marker and review dispatch for sync-quick runs and not know a silent full-suite re-dispatch happens. The earlier, longer entry covered both branches, and the last run shortened it to one.
- HARDENING: docs/INVENTORY.md:308 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The entry omits the FINAL_CI_FAILED_SYNC_QUICK=true branch.
  WHY: Suggested fix: append a clause saying that for a sync-quick run the script dispatches the head's full final CI run and posts no marker (1 line changed).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:308 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The entry says a failed final CI lint run posts a marker and dispatches PR review. For sync-quick failures the script dispatches a full CI run without posting a marker or dispatching review.
  WHY: No runtime code path is changed, but the inventory gives maintainers the wrong recovery behavior for a failed sync-quick run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:308 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The entry describes only the non-sync-quick path. For a failed sync-quick run, ci.yml:4604 passes FINAL_CI_FAILED_SYNC_QUICK=true, and scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:89-101 dispatches the head's full final CI run (FINAL_CI_FAILED_CI_WORKFLOW, default ci.yml) with no marker and no review dispatch.
  WHY: No runtime failure, but the entry contradicts the script and agents.d/9642-merge-base-sync-churn.md:7, so someone triaging a sync-quick failure would expect a marker that never appears.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
